topics.label: Lecture opening and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic and sets expectations for understanding the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition and pattern recognition receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the innate immune system senses pathogens and cellular damage through molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Inflammatory response propagation, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic pathology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the physiological mechanisms through which immune cells are activated, recruited to damaged tissues, connected to adaptive immunity, and potentially driven into systemic pathology.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic adaptations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss how inflammatory responses are shut down, how damaged tissues are repaired, and how persistent challenges lead to chronic inflammation and granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic wraps up the lecture and introduces the topic of the subsequent lecture.
